gaps.title: Fillet/Chamfer Incomplete Topological Blend & Non-Manifold Shell Generation
gaps.description: Fillet and Chamfer feature execution appends only a single blend/bevel face ('blend_east' / 'bevel_east') for a multi-edge loop, leaves adjacent vertical boundary faces untrimmed, and fails to delete or replace the original unchamfered top face. The resulting B-Rep shell is non-manifold (Euler characteristic chi=4 instead of 2, 8 boundary edges with degree=1).
gaps.impact: Downstream FEM meshing and boolean operations will fail on filleted/chamfered bodies because the boundary representation is geometrically open and self-intersecting.
gaps.remediationRequired: Implement true 3D edge trimming and corner vertex blend generation in FeatureExecution.ts, replacing the original face and stitching blend facets into a closed 2-manifold B-Rep shell.

gaps.title: Shell Volume Divergence Sign Reversal in computeVolume()
gaps.description: BRepKernel.computeVolume sums face signed tetrahedral volumes without respecting Orientation.REVERSED on inner cavity faces. As a result, inner cavity volume is added (+1194.67) instead of subtracted (-1194.67), yielding 4341.33 m^3 instead of the true 1952.00 m^3. The test suite passed only because FeatureExecution attached an artificial 'analyticVolume: 1952' override.
gaps.impact: Any analytical or simulation pipeline calling native computeVolume on hollow/shelled geometries receives an erroneous inflated volume (~222% of true physical volume).
gaps.remediationRequired: Multiply facet tetrahedral volume contributions by face orientation sign in BRepKernel.computeVolume: if (face.orientation === Orientation.REVERSED) volume -= dV; else volume += dV.

gaps.title: STEP AP242 Part 21 Entity Deserializer Dependent on Proprietary Comment Payload
gaps.description: STEPAP242Translator exports valid ISO 10303-21 text alongside an embedded base64 SECP_AP242_SEMANTIC_METADATA comment. However, importFromStepPart21 relies on that comment payload for geometry reconstruction. When parsing a pure, stripped STEP Part 21 file, it extracts zero solids and zero dimensions.
gaps.impact: Cannot import external CAD models generated by FreeCAD, OpenCASCADE, Siemens NX, or SolidWorks unless they contain SECP proprietary header annotations.
gaps.remediationRequired: Add native AST parser for MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP, CLOSED_SHELL, ADVANCED_FACE, and CARTESIAN_POINT to reconstruct native B-Rep solids directly from standard Part 21 DATA entities.

gaps.title: NURBS Surface Parameter Signature Inversion
gaps.description: BRepGeometry.ts constructor for BSplineSurface expects parameters in order (degreeU, degreeV, knotsU, knotsV, controlPoints), whereas procedural surface generators pass (degreeU, degreeV, controlNet, weights, knotsU, knotsV).
gaps.impact: Direct instantiation of BSplineSurface without standardizing parameters causes undefined evaluation at knot domain limits.
gaps.remediationRequired: Unify constructor parameter ordering across BRepGeometry.ts and NurbsEvaluator.ts with strong TypeScript interface types (BSplineSurfaceConfig).

gaps.title: Test Assertions Prefer Synthetic analyticVolume Over Topological Divergence
gaps.description: Phase 1 unit test assertions tested '(solid as any).analyticVolume ?? BRepKernel.computeVolume(solid)', allowing features with defective mesh topology to report passing status.
gaps.impact: Masked geometric and topological implementation gaps during Phase 1 qualification.
gaps.remediationRequired: Update test fixtures to enforce that raw facet divergence volume computed directly from the B-Rep boundary matches analytical tolerances within discretization bounds.

recommendationsForPhase1003: Execute Phase 1-003 remediation strictly targeting GAP-PH1-AUDIT-001 and GAP-PH1-AUDIT-002 before declaring kernel qualification.
Decouple STEP AP242 ingestion from comment payloads in Phase 2.
Enforce topological manifoldness checks (Euler characteristic, boundary degree count) in the BRepMutationGate.
